recommendations.name: The Fairphone 6 Plus
recommendations.blurb: For the first time, Fairphone is selling one of its ultra-repairable smartphones directly in the US. With its better chip and bump up to 12GB of RAM, the 6 Plus looks like a nice improvement from last year’s model.

recommendations.name: Framework’s Laptop 12
recommendations.blurb: Framework launched a second generation of its 12-inch convertible laptop, and it offers Intel’s latest Core Series 3 processors as well as options for a fingerprint reader and a backlit keyboard.

recommendations.name: Sennheiser’s Momentum True Wireless 5 earbuds
recommendations.blurb: Sennheiser’s redesigned wireless earbuds and the case both have user-replaceable batteries. They also come in some slick metallic colors. Apple, take note.

recommendations.name: Dartwords
recommendations.blurb: This new daily puzzle game from the creators of Blaseball tasks you with getting a darts bull’s-eye by guessing the correct word. If you’re getting bored with Wordle, Dartwords is a clever twist on the word game format.

recommendations.name: Mutiny
recommendations.blurb: This movie about Jason Statham doing Jason Statham action movie stuff on a cargo ship looks like a big, dumb, and fun summer blockbuster that’s probably a blast in theaters.

recommendations.name: Mortal Shell II
recommendations.blurb: I never played the first Mortal Shell, but I’m seeing a lot of praise for this new action RPG. Kotaku calls it a “third-person doom metal Soulslike,” and honestly, that’s all I need to hear.

recommendations.name: Polaroid’s Pokémon cameras
recommendations.blurb: A Polaroid camera that’s themed after a Poké Ball? This is the coolest thing for my 10-year-old self since the Pokédex toy.

recommendations.name: Still my iPhone 16 Pro I talked about last year
recommendations.blurb: The phone: Still my iPhone 16 Pro I talked about last year. I still think it’s too heavy and too big, and I still miss my iPhone 12 Mini. Next time, I’m going to buy whatever the lightest but newest iPhone is at that time.

recommendations.name: the grayscale mode
recommendations.blurb: I sometimes turn on the grayscale mode, too — I even have a Control Center toggle for it — but that’s a pain when I want to look at a picture of my daughter.

recommendations.name: Inside the Box
recommendations.blurb: My favorite book in recent memory is Inside the Box by David Epstein.

recommendations.name: Moon Ball
recommendations.blurb: The Moon Ball.

recommendations.name: XTeink
recommendations.blurb: Reading blog posts from the Atmosphere on my XTeink reader and loving it.

recommendations.name: The Incident at Galley House
recommendations.blurb: Played / playing three excellent indie mystery games on Steam Deck: The Incident at Galley House, The Excavation of Hob’s Barrow, and The Mermaid Mask.
recommendations.recommender: Matt (Jay note: I cosign The Mermaid Mask .) (reader)

recommendations.name: DIY vinyl kit
recommendations.blurb: Just found out that Teenage Engineering has a DIY vinyl kit and basically about to hand over all my money.

recommendations.name: Spaceplan
recommendations.blurb: I’ve been playing an ace wee app called Spaceplan. Simple and small, but tells a big story and insanely addictive. Add to that it’s cheap and there are no IAPs.

recommendations.name: Lost Weekend
recommendations.blurb: Lost Weekend, the new Phoebe Bridgers LP. It’s the ‘I’ve nicked your Dad’s copy of Vekatimest ’ to Olivia Rodrigo’s ‘I’ve nicked his Head On The Door.’

recommendations.name: on September 3rd
recommendations.blurb: The next series of Taskmaster, a hilarious show where five comedians compete in ridiculous tasks, debuts on September 3rd.

recommendations.name: sometime in September
recommendations.blurb: And The Great British Bake Off (aka The Great British Baking Show in the US) will also premiere sometime in September, though a specific date hasn’t been announced.
